title: gc beads city migrate-proxied result
description: Per-scope outcome of migrating a legacy GC-managed city to bd's proxied-server topology. ok:true means the report is complete; failed counts the scopes that did not migrate, and the process exit code carries the overall verdict.

ok.description: True when the command produced a complete report.

city.description: Absolute path of the city whose scopes were considered.

dry_run.description: True when no files were written.

failed.description: Number of scopes whose status is "failed".

scopes.description: One entry per scope considered, city first.

path.description: Absolute path of the scope root.

dolt_mode.description: The scope's dolt_mode in metadata.json after this run.

dolt_data_dir.description: Relative dolt_data_dir written so a rig shares the city's proxy root.

detail.description: Human-readable note about what was done or would be done.

error.description: Why this scope failed. Present only with status "failed".
